dashboard.body: Everything you need to run the store: products, stock, orders, settings and staff.

section.staff: Create, edit and deactivate staff accounts, and reset passwords.
section.presets: Ready-made permission sets you assign to staff.
section.workPhones: Register or revoke delivery-agent and order-monitor phones.
section.orders: Follow orders and move them along, as your permissions allow.
section.currencies: Enable currencies and record exchange rates with their history.
section.cashAccounts: Cash boxes and bank accounts, their balances and transfers.
section.periods: Accounting periods, the close checklist and reopening.
section.ledger: Trial balance and entries by account and document.
section.settings: Store data, business hours, timeouts and protection thresholds.
section.audit: Who changed what, when and why — filter by user, action, entity and date.
section.products: Products and their SKUs: unit, low-stock threshold, and a fixed or currency-linked price.
section.categories: Departments and subcategories (two levels only), and converting a category to a brand.
section.brands: Brands: create, edit and hide them.
section.stock: On hand, reserved, available and in custody — by warehouse, location, SKU or lot.
section.movements: Every stock movement, with its source document and who made it.
section.warehouses: Warehouses and their locations, and which locations are sellable.
section.openings: Opening stock documents: new lots with their cost and journal entry.
section.transfers: Move unreserved stock between locations, keeping each lot's identity.
section.counts: Physical counts: snapshot a scope, enter what was counted, approve the differences.
section.writeDowns: Write damaged or expired stock down to inventory loss.
section.purchasing: Receive purchase invoices into stock with pack sizes, landed costs and lots.
section.suppliers: Suppliers, their opening balances, statements and credits.
section.supplierPayments: Pay suppliers, allocate to invoices and see the FX gain or loss.
section.payables: What is owed to each supplier, and accounts-payable aging.
section.deliveryParties: Internal agents and external drivers, with the goods, cash and orders in their custody.
section.cashReceipts: Cash handed in by delivery parties, and the orders it settles.
section.custodyExceptions: Goods lost or damaged in custody, returns at the door and delivery-fee refunds.
section.trips: External drivers' trips: handover, outcomes, fare and the cash to settle.
section.deliveryZones: Delivery fees by governorate: zones, the governorates in each, and where you don't deliver yet.
section.discountTiers: An automatic discount that grows with the order, such as 5% from 150,000 IQD.
section.catalogImport: Add and update products and opening stock from an Excel file, with a preview before anything is saved.
section.catalogImages: Upload many product pictures at once in a ZIP, each named by its SKU.
section.returns: Review customer returns: approve, receive, inspect and refund.

products.newDescription: Fill in the basics, add pictures and variants, then choose whether the product shows in the store.
products.editDescription: Basics, pictures, and variants with their prices and units.

errors.price: Enter the price as a whole number, 0 or more.

variantErrors.skuTooLong: A SKU is at most 80 characters.
variantErrors.skuDuplicate: This SKU is repeated in the product.
variantErrors.attributes: Give each attribute both a name and a value (such as Colour = Red), without repeating a name.
variantErrors.sellingPrice: Enter a whole-number price, or leave it empty to use the product price.
variantErrors.threshold: Enter 0 or more, with at most three decimals.
variantErrors.referencePrice: Enter a reference price above zero, with at most six decimals.

sections.variantsHint: Each variant (size, colour, weight…) has its own stock code (SKU), unit and price. A product without variants keeps a single one.
sections.imagesHint: Add several pictures at once. The first one is the main picture.

fields.categoryHint: Products go into a subcategory of a department.
fields.priceHint: Every variant without its own price uses this one.
fields.nameEnHint: Left empty, the Arabic name is used.
fields.descriptionHint: Optional: specifications, sizes, how to use it.

variant.wholeForced: Pieces always sell in whole numbers.
variant.wholeOptional: Unticked, fractions up to three decimals are accepted ({unit}).
variant.attributesHint: Such as Colour = Red, Size = XL. Leave empty if the product has no variants.
variant.removeHint: A variant with stock or past orders cannot be removed.
variant.referenceHint: Includes the desired markup; the local price is always worked out from it.
variant.skuHint: A unique code for this variant, such as its barcode. Leave it and press “Fill in empty codes” to make one.

linked.chooseCurrency: Choose a reference currency to see the local price.
linked.noRate: No {code} rate yet. Record one in Currencies & rates first.
linked.enterReference: Enter the reference price to see the local price.
linked.roundingUnknown: The server applies the store's rounding rule (showing it needs the settings permission).
linked.roundingMultiple: Rounding: up to the next multiple of {multiple}.
linked.roundingPrecision: Rounding: to the base currency's precision ({precision} decimals).
linked.discountsAfter: Discounts apply after conversion and rounding.

reindex.title: Reindex product search?
reindex.body: Every product is sent to the search engine again. Products the engine could not take yet stay queued and are retried automatically. This can take a minute or more for a large catalog.
reindex.synchronized: Search is up to date: every product was indexed.
reindex.queued: {count, plural, one {# product is} other {# products are}} still queued; the automatic catch-up will retry.

products.belowCostNote: Raise the price or submit it for approval by another user.
products.approvalPendingBody: The live price was not changed. Another user with below-cost approval permission must approve or reject this request.
products.approvalPendingToast: The below-cost price change is pending approval.
products.copyNotice: This is a copy of “{name}” with its pictures, variants and prices. Change what differs and save; variant codes were moved on by one to stay unique, and the copy starts hidden.

bulk.label: Change the selected products
bulk.selectPage: Select every product on this page
bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# product selected} other {# products selected}}
bulk.done: {count, plural, =0 {No product changed.} one {# product changed.} other {# products changed.}}
bulk.failed: {count, plural, one {# product could not be changed and stays selected.} other {# products could not be changed and stay selected.}}
bulk.applying: Applying to {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}…
bulk.selectFirstMatching: Select the first {count} of {total} matching products

products.createdNext: Product created. Add the next one.

active.title: In the store
active.body: Customers see it and can order it once it has stock. Needs an approved price on every variant.

hidden.title: Hidden (draft)
hidden.body: Customers don't see it. Right for a product that isn't finished; show it later here or from the product list.

archived.title: Archived
archived.body: Discontinued: not shown to customers, kept in records and past orders.

products.noCategories: There are no subcategories yet, and a product needs one.
products.imagesBusy: Wait for the pictures to finish uploading, then save.
products.imagesFailed: Some pictures were not uploaded. Retry or remove them, then save.

nextSteps.title: Product created. What next?
nextSteps.published: The product is in the store and can be ordered once it has stock.
nextSteps.hidden: The product is hidden for now. Show it under “Visibility in the store” below when it is ready.
nextSteps.another: Add another product in the same category

linkedPrices.title: Linked-price preview
linkedPrices.roundingMultiple: up to the next multiple of {multiple}
linkedPrices.empty: No prices are linked to this currency; saving records the rate only.
linkedPrices.saveAndPublish: Save rate and publish linked prices
linkedPrices.publishForbidden: Publishing linked prices needs the “publish linked prices” permission.
linkedPrices.staleTitle: This preview is no longer valid
linkedPrices.staleBody: A rate, a linked SKU or the rounding rule changed since the preview, or it expired. Nothing was saved. Refresh the preview and review the new figures.
linkedPrices.publishedToast: Saved {rate} and published {count, plural, =0 {no prices} one {# price} other {# prices}}
linkedPrices.rateOnlyToast: Saved {rate} only; {count, plural, =0 {no linked prices} one {# price awaits it} other {# prices await it}}
linkedPrices.approvalPendingToast: The below-cost publish is pending approval; no rate or price was saved yet.

waiting.title: Waiting for another approver: {rate}
waiting.body: Some new prices fall below the protected threshold, so nothing was saved yet. Another person with the below-cost approval permission must approve it — you can't approve your own change.
waiting.share: Send this link to an approver:

skuPicker.forbidden: Searching SKUs needs the catalog.products permission.
skuPicker.needsCatalog: Choosing a SKU searches the catalog, which needs the catalog.products permission. Ask an administrator if you need it.

inventory.custodyHint: Units of this lot out with delivery agents (counted per lot, not per location).

documentsDescription.opening: Each opening document creates lots at a cost and posts Dr Inventory / Cr Opening equity.
documentsDescription.transfer: Transfers move unreserved stock between locations; the lot keeps its identity and value.
documentsDescription.count: A count snapshots a scope; approval posts shortages to inventory loss and surpluses to inventory gain.
documentsDescription.write_down: Write-downs remove damaged or expired stock from a non-sellable location and post the loss.

errors.wholeUnits: This SKU is counted in whole units only. Use a whole number.
errors.quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
errors.unitCost: Enter the unit cost (0 or more).
errors.future: The document date can't be in the future.
errors.openingValue: The opening stock must have a value above zero.
errors.overAvailable: More than can be taken here ({available}).
errors.reason: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
errors.quarantine: Choose a non-sellable location to move it to first.

stock.title: Stock
stock.description: Lot and location balances. Available is on hand minus reserved; non-sellable locations are never available to customers.
stock.catalogAvailable: The store sells {value} of this SKU now (sellable, unexpired, unreserved).
stock.partial: This SKU spans more lots than the summary reads; totals cover the first 500 rows.
stock.bySkuDescription: Availability per SKU as the store computes it, with each SKU's low-stock threshold.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.description: The append-only movement ledger, newest first. Nothing here can be edited; corrections are new documents.

warehouses.title: Warehouses & locations
warehouses.description: A warehouse or location can be deleted until stock has used it; after that it can only be deactivated, and only once it is empty.
warehouses.deleteBody: Only a warehouse or location that stock has never used can be deleted. If it was used, the server refuses and you can deactivate it instead.
warehouses.sellableHint: Stock here can be sold to customers. Untick for damaged, quarantine or returns-inspection areas.

opening.description: Bring existing stock into the system: each line creates a lot at a unit cost and the whole document posts once.
opening.forProduct: The quantities of “{name}” you have now, with their unit cost. The whole document posts at once.

inventory.fixAndReview: Correct the document and review it again — a changed document is posted under a new identity.
inventory.wholeUnitsHint: Whole units only for this SKU.
inventory.lotNumberHint: The supplier's or your own batch reference.
inventory.backdateHint: Required only when the date is in an earlier period than allowed.

transfer.description: Move unreserved stock between locations. The lot keeps its identity, expiry and cost; nothing is posted to the ledger.
transfer.pickHint: Only unreserved quantity can be moved; reserved stock stays with the orders holding it.

writeDown.description: Write damaged or expired stock down to inventory loss. Stock on a sellable shelf is moved to a non-sellable location first.
writeDown.needsTransferPermission: This stock is on a sellable shelf. Moving it first needs the inventory.transfer permission.
writeDown.twoSteps: {count, plural, one {# line is} other {# lines are}} on a sellable shelf: a transfer to the non-sellable location is posted first, then the write-down.
writeDown.movedAlready: The stock was moved. Confirming again posts only the write-down.
writeDown.pickHint: Damaged or expired lots. Expired lots show an Expired badge on the stock screen.
writeDown.limitUnreserved: Up to {value} (unreserved stock can be moved).
writeDown.moveHint: The stock is moved here by a transfer, then written down.
writeDown.noQuarantine: No active non-sellable location — create one under Warehouses

count.description: Snapshot the system quantities of one scope, count them, and approve the differences.
count.draftDescription: Enter what was counted. Approval posts shortages and surpluses, and is refused if stock moved in this scope after the snapshot.
count.approvedDescription: An approved count and what it posted.
count.missing: {count, plural, one {# line has} other {# lines have}} no counted quantity.
count.noDifferences: Counted quantities matched the system; nothing was posted.
count.carried: Counts carried over from {from}. {count, plural, =0 {Every line matched the new snapshot.} one {# line changed since and needs re-verifying.} other {# lines changed since and need re-verifying.}}
count.emptyScope: Nothing is stocked in this scope.
count.releaseExplain: Counting below what is reserved releases those reservations, and the orders holding them are flagged for inventory attention.
count.staleTitle: Stock moved in this scope after the snapshot.
count.staleBody: The server refused to approve, because the system quantities are no longer the ones counted against. Re-verify: take a fresh snapshot of the same scope — your counted quantities come with it, and lines that changed are marked to count again.
count.needsCountPermission: Taking a fresh snapshot needs the inventory.count permission.
count.needsAdjustPermission: Approving a count needs the inventory.adjust permission.
count.releasedBody: The orders holding these reservations were flagged for inventory attention. The API does not list which orders yet — look for them in Orders.

productStock.title: Stock
productStock.body: Read-only. Stock changes only through inventory documents — opening stock, transfers, counts and write-downs.

retrievals.title: Retrieval
retrievals.description: Goods coming back from an agent's custody, received in full or in part at their original issue cost.
retrievals.linesBody: Only what is in this agent's custody for the order is expected back.
retrievals.reviewBody: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} to receive.

errors.overOutstanding: More than what is still expected ({left}).
errors.location: Choose where to put it back.

list.title: Retrievals
list.description: Goods coming back from delivery parties, across all orders. Filter by party, order, date or status.

priceApprovals.title: Below-cost price approval
priceApprovals.description: Approve or reject a linked-price publish that puts some prices below the protected threshold.
priceApprovals.body: Approving publishes the new rate and prices; rejecting discards them. Either way, give a reason — it is kept in the audit log.
priceApprovals.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.
priceApprovals.ownRequest: You proposed this change, so you can't decide it. Another approver must approve or reject it.
priceApprovals.readOnly: You can inspect this request, but deciding it requires the below-cost approval permission.
priceApprovals.approvedBody: Approved: the rate and the linked prices are published.

parties.title: Delivery parties
parties.description: Everyone who carries orders: the store's agents (with the app) and external drivers (no account). Open a party to see the goods they hold.
parties.search: Search by name, phone or vehicle

notice.duplicatePhone: {name} was saved, but another delivery party already uses this phone number. Check it isn't the same person.
notice.deleted: {name} was deleted: nobody had used this driver yet.
notice.deactivated: {name} has deliveries, custody or retrievals on record, so the driver was kept and made inactive instead of deleted.

confirm.deactivateBody: The driver can no longer be chosen for new deliveries. Their history and any goods they hold stay as they are.
confirm.activateBody: The driver can be chosen for deliveries again.
confirm.removeBody: A driver nobody has used yet is deleted. A driver with any delivery, custody or retrieval is kept for the records and made inactive instead.

form.hint: A driver without an account. Staff assign them to orders and record their deliveries.
form.name: Name
form.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. 07701234567.

detail.title: Delivery party
detail.description: What this party holds right now, the orders it belongs to, and every movement in and out of their custody.

held.title: Orders held
held.none: No orders are in this party's hands.

statement.title: Custody statement
statement.hint: Goods issued to this party (+) and delivered or brought back (−), with the balance after each movement. Click an order to see only its movements.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Every order this party delivered, and what was collected for it: in full, short, or not confirmed yet.

custodyOverview.title: Custody overview
custodyOverview.description: What each delivery party holds right now: cash for the store, orders whose goods they carry, and the oldest item's age.

cash.title: Cash activity
cash.hint: Cash collected for the store, handed in, and reversed, with the running balance — for the same dates and order as the statement above.
cash.paged: Showing {shown} of {total}; page through the statement above for more.

fields.title: Cash collected
fields.amountInvalid: Enter the amount collected in numbers, e.g. 25000.
fields.notConfirmedHint: The order is delivered now; the amount is confirmed later from the Cash to confirm list.

preview.full: The full amount: nothing is short.
preview.short: Short by {shortfall}. The shortfall is recorded against the party.
preview.over: More than is due. Enter at most the amount due.
preview.unconfirmed: Revenue is recorded now; no cash is counted until the amount is confirmed.

queue.title: Cash to confirm
queue.description: Delivered orders whose amount collected isn't confirmed yet, oldest first. Confirm what the party handed in: the full amount, or less (a shortfall).
queue.empty: Every delivered order's cash is confirmed.
queue.confirmBody: Enter what the party handed in. This posts once; it can't be changed afterwards.

filters.note: Days are Baghdad business days of delivery; amounts are the amount due.

ignored.dates: The start day is after the end day, so the date filter isn't applied.
ignored.amounts: The lowest amount is above the highest, so the amount filter isn't applied.

receive.title: Receive cash
receive.description: Cash a delivery party hands in, into a cash account, and the orders it settles. Whatever isn't allocated now stays unallocated, to allocate later.
receive.pickPartyHint: Choose who is handing cash in to see what they hold and which orders aren't settled yet.
receive.needsCashAccounts: Receiving cash needs permission to view cash accounts.
receive.noAccounts: There is no active IQD cash account to receive into.
receive.amountHint: At most the cash the party holds.
receive.allocationsBody: Unsettled collections, oldest first. Allocate oldest first automatically, or type an amount per order. Whatever you don't allocate stays unallocated on the receipt.
receive.noAllocatePermission: Allocating to orders needs the cash_receipts.allocate permission; the whole amount will stay unallocated.
receive.reviewBody: Receive {amount} from {party}: {allocated} allocated to orders, {unallocated} unallocated. This posts once and can only be undone by a reversal.

errors.party: Choose the party handing cash in.

allocation.none: No confirmed collections are waiting to be settled.

problems.amount: Enter the amount received, in whole dinars.
problems.overCustody: That is more than the cash this party holds.
problems.overRow: Order {order}: more than is unsettled on it.
problems.overAmount: The allocations add up to more than the amount.
problems.invalidRow: Order {order}: enter the amount in numbers.

refusals.overAllocation: Refused: the allocations add up to more than what is still unallocated on this receipt. Someone may have allocated part of it meanwhile — reload and check.
refusals.wrongParty: Refused: one of the orders was delivered by another party. A receipt can only settle the orders of the party who handed the cash in.
refusals.moreThanCollected: Refused: an allocation is more than is still unsettled on that order. It may have been settled meanwhile — reload and check.
refusals.notConfirmed: Refused: only orders whose collected cash is confirmed can be settled.
refusals.duplicateOrder: Refused: an order appears twice in the allocations.
refusals.overCustody: Refused: the amount is more than the cash this party holds now. Reload to see what they hold.
refusals.ownReceipt: You posted this receipt, so you cannot reverse it. Another user must reverse it (separation of duties).
refusals.ownCustody: You can't receive or settle cash from your own custody (separation of duties).
refusals.strictAllocation: Under strict separation of duties another user must allocate this receipt. Receive it without allocations, then ask a colleague to allocate it.
refusals.alreadyReversed: This receipt has already been reversed.
refusals.reversedReceipt: A reversed receipt cannot be allocated.
refusals.collectionNotFound: Refused: one of the orders has no delivered collection.

detail.title: Cash receipt
detail.description: Cash handed in by a delivery party, the orders it settles, and its reversal if any.
detail.reversedNote: The cash went back into the party's custody and the orders it settled are unsettled again. The original documents are kept as they were.
detail.noAllocations: Nothing has been allocated from this receipt.
detail.allocateBody: Settle the party's unsettled orders from what is still unallocated on this receipt.
detail.allocateEmpty: Enter at least one amount to allocate.
detail.reverseBody: The cash goes back into the party's custody and every allocation from this receipt stops counting. The receipt itself is kept, marked reversed. The person who posted it cannot reverse it.

list.title: Cash receipts
list.description: Cash handed in by delivery parties, newest first.
list.unallocatedDescription: Active receipts with cash not yet allocated to orders, oldest first.
list.ignoredDates: The start date is after the end date, so the date filter isn't applied.

partySearch.placeholder: Search by name, phone or vehicle

refusals.receiptConsumed: Refused: a cash receipt has already taken in this loss charged to the party. Reverse that cash receipt first, then reverse this exception.
refusals.ownException: You recorded this exception, so you cannot reverse it. Another user must reverse it (separation of duties).
refusals.ownCustody: You can't record or reverse an exception in your own custody (separation of duties).
refusals.strictRecorder: Under strict separation of duties another user must record this exception (not the person who delivered or handed over the order).
refusals.alreadyReversed: This exception has already been reversed.
refusals.notInCustody: Refused: the order's goods are no longer in the party's custody.
refusals.noParty: Refused: no delivery party holds this order.
refusals.noShortfall: Refused: a return at the door needs the order delivered with less collected than due.
refusals.noUncollected: Refused: nothing is left uncollected on this order to set the amount against.
refusals.feeCap: Refused: refunds would exceed the delivery fee charged on this order.
refusals.notDelivered: Refused: the delivery fee can be refunded only once the order is delivered.
refusals.notSold: Refused: only goods already delivered from custody can be returned.
refusals.notInThisCustody: Refused: those goods don't belong to this order and party.
refusals.overCustody: Refused: more than the party holds of those goods.
refusals.noValue: Refused: the goods have no value to record.
refusals.inactiveAccount: Refused: the refund needs an active IQD cash account.
refusals.duplicateHolding: Refused: the same goods are listed twice.

create.title: Record a custody exception
create.description: Goods lost or damaged in a delivery party's custody, goods the customer refused at the door, or a refund of the delivery fee — one numbered document, posted once.
create.lossBody: The goods the party held for this order that were lost or damaged, at their original issue cost. Choose who bears the cost: the store (an expense) or the party (added to the cash they owe).

bearerHints.party: Added to the cash the party owes; they hand it in with a cash receipt.

create.returnBody: The customer took part of the order and refused the rest at the door. The order is delivered with what they paid, and the refused goods go back into stock against what was left unpaid — the party is no longer expected to bring that cash.
create.deliveredFirst: The order is delivered with the amount collected. The return wasn't recorded yet — record it again to finish.
create.refundBody: The order was charged {fee} for delivery. Refund all or part of it from a cash account, or set it against what is still uncollected on the order.

methods.uncollected: The amount still uncollected on the order

errors.quantities: Enter a quantity for at least one item, no more than is held.
errors.location: Choose where the goods go back into stock.
errors.collected: Enter the amount collected, less than what is due.
errors.amount: Enter the refund in whole dinars.

unavailable.goods_loss: Nothing to record: the party holds none of this order's goods (a loss is recorded while the goods are out for delivery, or after a failed delivery).
unavailable.return_against_uncollected: A return at the door is recorded while the order is out for delivery with a delivery party.
unavailable.returnAfterDelivery: This order is already delivered short. Its delivered goods can't be listed here (the API offers no read of them), so record a return at the door while the order is still out for delivery.
unavailable.returnNeedsDeliver: Recording a return at the door also marks the order delivered, which needs the orders.deliver permission.
unavailable.delivery_fee_refund: Nothing to refund: the order has no delivery fee, or isn't delivered yet.
unavailable.fullyRefunded: The delivery fee is already fully refunded.

list.title: Custody exceptions
list.description: Lost or damaged goods, returns at the door and delivery-fee refunds, newest first.
list.howTo: Record an exception from the order, or from the party's custody.
list.ignoredDates: The start date is after the end date, so the date filter isn't applied.

detail.title: Custody exception
detail.description: One custody exception, its goods and postings, and its reversal if any.
detail.receiptRule: A loss charged to the party can't be reversed once a cash receipt has taken it in: reverse that cash receipt first.
detail.reverseBody: Every posting and stock movement it made is undone by a reversal document; the exception itself is kept, marked reversed. The person who recorded it cannot reverse it.

record.return_against_uncollected: Record a return at the door

bearers.customer_direct: Paid by the customer to the driver

blockers.notDelivered: Not delivered, returned or resolved yet

refusals.unresolved: Closing was refused: every order must be delivered with a confirmed amount, returned, or otherwise resolved first. Still open:
refusals.ownTrip: You created this trip, so you cannot close it. Another user must close and settle it (separation of duties).
refusals.doubleCharge: Refused: with a customer-paid fare the store's delivery fee on the order must be zero, or the customer would pay for delivery twice.
refusals.acceptanceNote: With a customer-paid fare, note the customer's acceptance of paying the driver.
refusals.notOpen: Orders are added, and the trip started, only while it is open.
refusals.notInProgress: Only a trip in progress can be closed.
refusals.noOrders: A trip needs at least one order before it starts.
refusals.sharesMismatch: Refused: the orders' fare shares must add up to the trip's fare.
refusals.notAssigned: Refused: the order isn't waiting for dispatch with a delivery to hand over.
refusals.driverNotFound: Refused: the driver isn't an active external driver.
refusals.nettingTooLarge: The driver can't keep more fare than the cash collected and not yet handed in.
refusals.inactiveAccount: Refused: the fare needs an active IQD cash account.

list.title: Driver trips
list.description: External drivers' trips: the orders handed over, the fare and the cash to settle, newest first.
list.ignoredDates: The start date is after the end date, so the date filter isn't applied.

create.title: New driver trip
create.description: One external driver, one fare for the whole trip, and the orders you hand over to them next.

bearerHints.store: The store pays the driver; the fare is the store's expense.
bearerHints.customer_direct: The customer pays the driver directly; it never enters the store's money, and the orders must carry no store delivery fee.

methodHints.payable: Recorded as owed to the driver when the trip closes.
methodHints.cash_account: Paid from a cash account when the trip closes.
methodHints.driver_keeps: The driver keeps it from the cash collected; it is netted when the trip closes.
methodHints.customer_direct: Nothing for the store to settle.

create.agreement: Agreement for failed or cancelled deliveries (optional)
create.agreementHint: What the driver is paid when a delivery fails or is cancelled.

errors.fare: Enter the fare in whole dinars.

detail.title: Driver trip
detail.description: The orders on this trip and what happened to each, the fare, and the cash expected and received.
detail.agreement: Agreement for failed or cancelled deliveries
detail.noOrders: No orders yet. Add the orders you hand over to the driver.
detail.customerDirectNote: The fare is paid by the customers to the driver directly and isn't part of this cash.

results.settled: Settled: the cash expected was handed in.
results.settlement_open: Closed with cash still open: the difference stays in the driver's custody until handed in.

detail.addBody: Orders ready for dispatch. Each takes its share of the trip's fare; the shares must add up to the fare before the trip starts.
detail.addBodyCustomer: Orders ready for dispatch with no store delivery fee. Note the customer's acceptance of paying the driver.
detail.shareHint: {left} of the fare is not shared out yet.
detail.acceptanceHint: How the customer agreed to pay the driver directly.
detail.noReady: No orders ready for dispatch match.
detail.sharesMatch: The fare shares add up to the fare ({fare}).
detail.sharesOff: The fare shares add up to {shares}, not the fare ({fare}).
detail.blockedBody: These orders still need an outcome before the trip can close:
detail.previewSettled: Closing settles it: {expected} expected, all handed in.
detail.previewShort: Closing leaves a difference: {expected} expected, {received} handed in, {netted} kept as fare — {difference} still to hand in stays in the driver's custody.
detail.previewOver: Closing leaves a difference: {expected} expected but {received} handed in — {difference} more than collected stays unallocated.

modules.disabledBody: This part of the back office is not switched on for this store yet.
modules.disabledHint: It can be enabled later as an add-on without affecting anything you have entered. Ask your system administrator.

images.dropHint: Drop pictures here or choose them from your device. Up to {max}; they are shrunk before uploading.
images.dropHintSingle: One JPG, PNG or WebP picture; it is shrunk before uploading.
images.tooMany: At most {max} pictures; only the first ones were added.
images.orderHint: The first picture is the main one shown in the store. Drag a picture by its handle to reorder, or use the arrows.
images.empty: No pictures yet. Products with clear pictures sell faster.

failure.type: Unsupported format. Use JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF.
failure.tooLarge: The picture is too large (over 8 MB even after shrinking).
failure.upload: The picture could not be uploaded. Check the connection and retry.
failure.forbidden: You don't have permission to upload pictures.
failure.decode: This picture could not be read. Try another one.

deliveryZones.description: Each zone has a delivery fee and a set of governorates. Customers pay their governorate's zone fee at checkout.
deliveryZones.unservedTitle: {count, plural, one {# governorate you don't deliver to} other {# governorates you don't deliver to}}
deliveryZones.unservedHint: Customers there cannot check out until the governorate is in an active zone.
deliveryZones.allServed: Every active governorate is in an active delivery zone.
deliveryZones.oneZoneRule: A governorate belongs to one zone only.
deliveryZones.empty: No delivery zones yet. Add a zone and choose its governorates.
deliveryZones.deactivated: “{name}” deactivated: its governorates are not served until it is active again.
deliveryZones.deleteBody: The zone is deleted and its governorates are left without a zone — not served until another zone takes them. Past orders keep their fee.

errors.fee: Enter a whole-number fee of 0 or more.

fields.nameEnHint: Left empty, the Arabic name is used.

deliveryZones.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {none selected} one {# governorate} other {# governorates}}
deliveryZones.conflictRefused: Not saved: a governorate can belong to one zone only.
deliveryZones.conflictHint: Remove them from that zone first, or unselect them here.
deliveryZones.conflictRefusedStale: Not saved: a governorate was just added to another zone. Refresh the page and try again.

governorates.title: Governorates
governorates.description: The 18 governorates and Halabja. Inactive ones are not offered in customers' addresses.
governorates.activeHint: An inactive governorate leaves the address forms; saved addresses stay as they are.

discountTiers.title: Automatic discounts
discountTiers.description: A percentage off that grows with the goods in the order. The highest tier an order reaches applies automatically, no coupon needed.
discountTiers.stackingOff: Automatic discounts don't combine with coupons: a customer with a coupon gets whichever discount is larger.
discountTiers.stackingOn: Automatic discounts currently combine with coupons (store setting).
discountTiers.noDeliveryFee: The discount is on the goods only, never the delivery fee.
discountTiers.empty: No automatic discounts. Add a tier, such as 5% on orders from 150,000 IQD.
discountTiers.exampleEmpty: Enter the minimum and the percent to see an example.
discountTiers.notBetter: This tier is no better than a lower one, so nobody benefits from it.
discountTiers.deleteBody: New orders stop getting it. Past orders keep their discount.

errors.minimum: Enter a whole-number minimum of 0 or more.
errors.percent: Enter a percent above 0 and up to 50, with at most two decimals.
errors.thresholdTaken: Another tier already uses this minimum.

fields.minimumHint: Before the discount, without the delivery fee.

catalogImport.title: Import products from Excel
catalogImport.description: Add new products or update existing ones by SKU, and enter opening stock, from one file. Every row is checked first; nothing is saved until you apply it.

template.title: 1. Download the template
template.body: The template is an Excel file with Arabic and English headers and an instructions sheet. Don't rename the sheets or the headers, and delete the two example rows before uploading.

upload.title: 2. Upload the filled-in workbook
upload.fileHint: Up to 5,000 rows in total across the products and stock sheets.
upload.notWorkbook: That isn't an .xlsx file. Save the workbook as Excel (.xlsx) and choose it again.
upload.createMissingHelp: Categories have exactly two levels: a main category (level 1, e.g. Electronics) and a subcategory under it (level 2, e.g. Headphones). A product always goes in a subcategory. With this option on, a main category, subcategory or brand that doesn't exist yet is created hidden, so you can check the names before customers see them. With it off, those rows show as errors.

progress.label: Checking progress
progress.background: Large file: checking runs in the background. You can leave this page and come back to it from the import history below.
progress.failed: This file could not be checked. Make sure it comes from the template, then upload it again.

preview.title: 3. Review the preview
preview.nothingWritten: Nothing has been saved yet. Fix the errors in Excel and upload again, or apply only the valid rows.

actionHelp.create: A new product or variant will be added.
actionHelp.update: The SKU exists: its details will be updated.
actionHelp.warning: Will be applied, with a note worth checking.
actionHelp.error: Won't be applied until you fix it.

preview.search: Find a SKU or a cell (e.g. H4)
preview.createsTaxonomy: “Create missing” is on: new categories and brands are created hidden.

commit.title: 4. Apply the valid rows
commit.button: Apply {count, plural, one {# valid row} other {# valid rows}}
commit.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row with an error will be skipped.} other {# rows with errors will be skipped.}}
commit.once: An import is applied once only, even if the button is pressed twice.
commit.stockNote: The stock rows create one opening-stock document.
commit.none: There are no valid rows to apply. Fix the errors and upload again.

report.hint: Every row with its result and the cell to fix; opens in Excel.

errors.CATALOG_IMPORT_FILE_INVALID: The file could not be read. Save it as Excel (.xlsx) from the template and upload it.
errors.CATALOG_IMPORT_HEADERS_INVALID: The column headers don't match the template. Download the template again and copy your data into it without changing the headers.
errors.CATALOG_IMPORT_SHEET_REQUIRED: The “Products+Variants” sheet is missing. Don't rename the template's sheets.
errors.CATALOG_IMPORT_ROW_LIMIT: The file has more than 5,000 rows. Split it into smaller files.
errors.CATALOG_IMPORT_STOCK_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: The stock sheet needs the manage-inventory and view-cost permissions. Remove the stock rows or ask for the permissions.
errors.CATALOG_IMPORT_NOT_READY: The file hasn't finished checking yet.
errors.CATALOG_IMPORT_NO_VALID_ROWS: There are no valid rows to apply.
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than allowed. Split it into smaller files.
errors.CATALOG_IMPORT_OPERATION_ID_REUSED: That operation id belongs to another import. Reload the page and try again.
errors.CATALOG_IMPORT_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE: The import service isn't available right now. Nothing was applied; try again in a minute.

help.title: How to fill in the workbook
help.intro: Each row of the “Products+Variants” sheet is one variant with its own SKU. Rows with the same names, category and brand become one product with several variants (colours, sizes). If the SKU already exists, the row updates that variant — so fill in the whole row.
help.sheets: The “Stock” sheet is optional: each row is a quantity of a SKU at a location in your warehouses, and together they become one opening-stock document.

columns.category_level_1: The main category (level 1). Write the Arabic or English name, or “English | عربي”.
columns.category_level_2: The subcategory inside the main category (level 2). The product always goes here.
columns.brand: The brand, by name. Leave empty when there is none.
columns.product_name_ar: The product name customers see in Arabic.
columns.sku: The stock code, unique per variant. It decides whether a row is new or an update, and it matches the pictures.
columns.attributes: The variant's attributes, like color=black;size=L, or JSON. Leave empty for a product without variants.
columns.base_unit: The selling unit, like piece or kg.
columns.whole_units_only: Sold in whole units only? Write yes or no (or نعم/لا). Don't leave it empty.
columns.price_iqd: The selling price in Iraqi dinars. Leave it empty only when the price is linked to another currency.
columns.reference_currency_code: For a currency-linked price: the currency code, like USD; it must be enabled in Currencies & rates.
columns.reference_price: The price in the linked currency; the dinar price comes from the recorded exchange rate.
columns.low_stock_threshold: When the quantity drops to this number, the product shows as low stock.
columns.status: active shows it in the store, hidden hides it, archived archives it. Left empty, a new product stays hidden.
columns.image_url_1: Picture links on the internet (up to three columns), downloaded when the import is applied. Or upload pictures later from Bulk images.

stockColumns.sku: A SKU that exists, or that the products sheet of the same file adds.
stockColumns.location_code: The location code as in Warehouses & locations (e.g. MAIN-A1).
stockColumns.unit_cost_iqd: The unit cost in dinars. Only people with the view-cost permission see it.
stockColumns.expiry: The expiry date as 2027-12-31, or leave empty.

help.errorsTitle: Common errors and how to fix them
help.errorsHint: In the preview each error names its cell (e.g. Products+Variants!H4: column H, row 4).

CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND.what: The category or subcategory doesn't exist.
CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND.fix: Correct the name as it appears in Categories, or turn on “Create missing categories and brands”.

BRAND_NOT_FOUND.fix: Correct the name, leave the cell empty, or turn on the create option.

SKU_DUPLICATE_IN_FILE.what: The SKU appears twice in the file.
SKU_DUPLICATE_IN_FILE.fix: Give each variant its own SKU, or delete the repeated row.

BARCODE_DUPLICATE.what: The barcode is used by another variant.
BARCODE_DUPLICATE.fix: Correct the barcode or leave it empty.

PRICE_REQUIRED.fix: Write the dinar price, or the linked currency with the reference price.

PRICE_INVALID.what: The price isn't a valid number.
PRICE_INVALID.fix: Write digits only, without a currency or text, like 25000.

CURRENCY_INVALID.fix: Write a three-letter code like USD.

CURRENCY_NOT_ENABLED.fix: Enable it in Currencies & rates, or use a dinar price.

EXCHANGE_RATE_REQUIRED.what: There is no exchange rate for this currency.
EXCHANGE_RATE_REQUIRED.fix: Record the rate in Currencies & rates, then check the file again.

ATTRIBUTES_INVALID.fix: Write them like color=black;size=L (name=value, separated by semicolons).

LOW_STOCK_INVALID.fix: Write zero or a larger number, or leave it empty.

STATUS_DEFAULTED.fix: Only a warning: a new product stays hidden until you show it.

SKU_NOT_FOUND.fix: Add the product in the products sheet of the same file, or correct the code.

LOCATION_NOT_FOUND.what: The location code doesn't exist or isn't active.
LOCATION_NOT_FOUND.fix: Copy the code from Warehouses & locations.

LOCATION_CODE_AMBIGUOUS.what: The location code is used in more than one warehouse.
LOCATION_CODE_AMBIGUOUS.fix: Make location codes unique in Warehouses & locations.

QUANTITY_INVALID.fix: Write a number above zero, without fractions for a whole-units product.

UNIT_COST_INVALID.fix: Write zero or a larger number.

EXPIRY_INVALID.what: The expiry date can't be read.

apply.title: Applying the import
apply.background: It runs on the server: you can leave or close this page and the import carries on. Reopen it any time from the import history.
apply.partialBody: Rows applied: {applied} (they stay applied). Rows not applied yet: {remaining}.
apply.failedTitle: The import could not be applied
apply.resumeHelp: Fix the cause first (for example, record a missing exchange rate). Resuming continues where it stopped: rows already applied are not applied again.

catalogImages.title: Bulk image upload
catalogImages.description: Upload a ZIP of product pictures, each named by its SKU, and they are added to the matching products.

naming.title: How to name the pictures
naming.body: Name each picture by the variant's SKU and put them all in one ZIP file. For a second and third picture add -2 and -3 at the end of the name. Pictures are added after the product's current ones.
naming.formats: Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF. Other files in the archive are ignored.

catalogImages.notZip: That isn't a .zip file. Put the pictures in a ZIP archive and choose it.
catalogImages.processing: Matching the pictures to products and saving them…

result.title: Upload result
result.matched: {count, plural, =0 {No picture was added} one {# picture added} other {# pictures added}}
result.unmatched: {count, plural, =0 {Every file matched a product.} one {# file didn't match any SKU.} other {# files didn't match any SKU.}}
result.unmatchedHelp: Make sure the file name is exactly the SKU (-2 and -3 may follow), then upload just these files in a new ZIP.

errors.CATALOG_IMAGE_ZIP_INVALID: The file couldn't be opened as a ZIP archive. Create the archive again and upload it.
errors.tooLarge: The archive is too large or has too many pictures. Split it into several ZIP files.
errors.generic: The pictures couldn't be uploaded. Try again.

list.title: Customer returns
list.description: Return requests and where each one is in the flow, newest first.
list.orderForbidden: Searching by order number needs permission to view orders (orders.view).
list.ignoredDates: The start date is after the end date, so the date filter isn't applied.

detail.title: Return
detail.description: The return's lines, its money and the next step.
detail.customerHidden: Shown with permission to view orders
detail.waiting: Next step: {step}. It needs the {permission} permission, which you don't have.
detail.restocked: Back in stock at original cost
detail.netPaidHint: Net paid is this line's share of what the customer paid, fixed when the order was placed: its price less its share of the order's discounts and points. Refunds come from it, never from today's prices.
detail.feePolicy: The delivery fee is refunded automatically only when the whole order is returned for a store error, a wrong item or a defect. All returns of an order together can never refund more than the fee charged.
detail.feePolicyRefunded: The delivery fee is part of this refund.
detail.feePolicyNone: No delivery fee is refunded for this return.
detail.pointsEffectBody: {reversed} earned points reversed · {restored} redeemed points restored · net {net}
detail.pointsApplied: Applied with the refund. A negative net is taken from future rewards, never from the cash refund.
detail.pointsPending: Applied when the refund is paid. A negative net is taken from future rewards, never from the cash refund.

done.inspect: Inspection posted: the goods are in their locations.

approve.title: Approve or reject
approve.body: Approve the quantities you accept for each line (0 to refuse a line), or reject the whole return.
approve.zeroHint: Enter 0 to refuse a line. At least one line must be approved; otherwise reject the return.
approve.rejectReason: Reason for rejecting (the customer sees it)
approve.rejectReasonRequired: Write a reason of at least 3 characters.
approve.feePolicy: Delivery fee: the server refunds it automatically only for a full return caused by a store error, a wrong item or a defect.
approve.feeInvalid: Enter a whole number of dinars.
approve.feeReasonRequired: Write a reason of at least 3 characters.
approve.empty: No line is approved. Approve at least one line, or reject the return.

quantity.whole: This product is sold in whole pieces.

receive.title: Receive the goods
receive.body: Record that the approved goods are back with the store. Nothing enters stock until they are inspected.

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.body: For each line, record its condition and the location it goes to.
inspect.noLocations: No active stock location is available. Add one under Warehouses first.
inspect.locationMismatch: This location doesn't fit the condition.
inspect.costRule: Sellable goods go back into stock at their original issue cost. Opened, damaged or expired goods go to a non-sellable location and are written down.

refund.title: Refund
refund.body: Pay the customer what is still owed after inspection, and apply the loyalty points.
refund.offsetNote: {offset} of the refund was set against cash the customer never paid.
refund.pointsNote: Earned points are reversed and redeemed points restored at the same time.
refund.nothingToPay: There is no cash to pay: the whole refund was set against unpaid cash. Recording this step applies the points and closes the return.
refund.cashAccountsForbidden: Choosing a cash account needs permission to view cash accounts (cash_accounts.view).
refund.proofHint: E.g. the signed receipt the party gave the customer.

refusals.RETURN_INVALID_STATE: Someone else already moved this return to another step. Reload the page to see where it is.
refusals.RETURN_REJECTION_HAS_LINES: A whole rejection can't carry line quantities.
refusals.RETURN_REJECTION_REASON_REQUIRED: Write a reason for the rejection.
refusals.RETURN_APPROVAL_INCOMPLETE: Every line needs an approved quantity (0 to refuse it).
refusals.RETURN_APPROVAL_EXCEEDS_REQUEST: An approved quantity is more than the customer asked to return.
refusals.RETURN_APPROVAL_EMPTY: No line is approved. Approve at least one line, or reject the return.
refusals.RETURN_DELIVERY_FEE_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: A delivery-fee exception needs the returns.refund_delivery_fee permission.
refusals.RETURN_DELIVERY_FEE_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for the delivery-fee exception.
refusals.RETURN_DELIVERY_FEE_EXCEEDS_CHARGED: All returns of this order together would refund more than the delivery fee charged.
refusals.RETURN_INSPECTION_INCOMPLETE: Every approved line must be inspected.
refusals.RETURN_LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: A chosen location is inactive or doesn't exist any more.
refusals.RETURN_LOCATION_CONDITION_MISMATCH: Sellable goods need a sellable location; opened, damaged or expired goods a non-sellable one.
refusals.RETURN_EXCEEDS_ISSUED_QUANTITY: More would come back than was issued for this order line.
refusals.INVENTORY_COST_NEGATIVE: Posting this would make a stock cost negative. Check the line's stock history.
refusals.RETURN_REFUND_METHOD_FIELDS_INVALID: A cash refund needs only the cash account.
refusals.RETURN_CUSTODY_REFUND_PROOF_REQUIRED: A custody refund needs the order's collection and a proof reference.
refusals.RETURN_CASH_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: Choose an active IQD cash account.
refusals.RETURN_COLLECTION_UNAVAILABLE: The order's delivery collection isn't available to refund from.
refusals.RETURN_REFUND_EXCEEDS_CUSTODY: The delivery party doesn't hold enough of this order's cash. Refund from a cash account instead.
refusals.RETURN_REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAID: The refund would be more than the customer actually paid for this order.
refusals.SKU_WHOLE_UNITS_ONLY: This product is sold in whole pieces: use whole numbers.
refusals.RETURN_QUANTITY_PRECISION: Quantities take at most 3 decimal places.
refusals.SEPARATION_OF_DUTIES_VIOLATION: Separation of duties: this step must be done by a different person from the one who did the previous step (or created the return).
refusals.PERIOD_CLOSED: The accounting period for today is closed, so the server refused to post. Ask for the period to be reopened.
